name: Chat with a document
description: Search document text with BM25 keyword scoring and get quoted passages plus the score that ranked them. Runs entirely in your browser.

seo.metaTitle: Chat with a document — 100% Private In-Browser Utility | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Ask a question about a document and get the best-matching passages quoted with their BM25 score. Deterministic keyword retrieval in your browser, no embeddings, no uploads.
seo.aeoSummary: Chat with a document splits text into passages and ranks them with BM25 scoring inside your browser tab. No embedding model is downloaded, and no text is uploaded.

faqs.question: Does Chat with a document upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.answer: No. Chat with a document executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using BM25 keyword scoring. No data leaves your device.
faqs.q: Does Chat with a document upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.a: No. Chat with a document executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using BM25 keyword scoring. No data leaves your device.

faqs.question: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate Chat with a document?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/chat_pdf.json or open /tools/chat-pdf?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.

task: Answer questions from document text with local keyword retrieval
desc: Split pasted document text into passages, rank them against your question with BM25 keyword scoring, and quote the best passages with the score that found them. Retrieval is deterministic: you can see why a passage was chosen, and the answer is quoted rather than generated.
